Priya (AmberField): Hey team — since last evening we're getting big p99 spikes on embeddings (customer-facing search). p95 is fine but p99 jumps to ~3.2s and users see timeouts. Started after their nightly batch run.
alex (support): Thanks Priya — opening an incident ticket, can you confirm region and sample request ID? Any changes on your side? :eyes:
Priya (AmberField): region us-west-2, sample request id: req_20241111_8b9f. No infra changes on our side — same batch job that runs daily.
alex (support): copying eng-sre and eng-platform. Morgan, Lee — looks like tenant amberfield experiencing tail latency during bulk embed jobs; p99 ~3s. Can you triage? infra-bot: Incident #INC-20241111-amberfield created. Priority P2.
morgan (eng-sre): digging in — quick check: noisy neighbor or KV-cache thrash are suspects. Can you paste the curl you use for the batch job? Also any concurrency config? Priya: we run 40 concurrent workers, each sending 2k token average payloads in parallel.
morgan (eng-sre): that'll increase KV cache misses + sequence length variance. Temporary mitigation: recommend throttling concurrency to 10 workers or use ephemeral reservation. Want me to provision a 10-min reservation for you now? :thumbsup:
Priya (AmberField): yes please, that would help while you investigate.
lee (eng-platform): also checking routing and recent deploys — no model or runtime deploys in last 24h. I'm seeing increased queue latency on shard rwest-3 for tenant amberfield around 03:12 UTC.
morgan (eng-sre): logs show request queueing spikes and occasional preemption eviction of best-effort pods. Snippet:
```
2024-11-11T03:12:14Z amberfield req=req_20241111_8b9f queue_time=620ms exec_time=2400ms pod=best-effort-77 preempted=false
2024-11-11T03:12:50Z amberfield req=req_20241111_8b9g queue_time=1800ms exec_time=1600ms pod=best-effort-81 preempted=true
```
morgan (eng-sre): second line shows preemption coinciding with high queue_time -> likely noisy tenant(s) or autoscaler thrash. Lee, can we check per-tenant rate limiting events and priority lanes? 
lee (eng-platform): checking. There are a few high-burst tokens from tenant "sableharbor" on same shard at that window — they hit burst policy and started spilling to best-effort pool which may have caused preemptions.
alex (support): action items: 1) provision 10-min reservation for amberfield on rwest-3 2) add amberfield to temporary allowlist for priority lane (manual) 3) ask amberfield to reduce batch concurrency to 10 until we complete follow-up.
Priya (AmberField): reservation + allowlist appreciated — we'll throttle to 10 immediately and confirm within 5m.
lee (eng-platform): done: created ephemeral reservation res_amber_10m on rwest-3 and added amberfield to manual priority allowlist for 12m. infra-bot: Reservation res_amber_10m created by lee (eng-platform) expires in 12 minutes.
morgan (eng-sre): monitoring p99 — initial readings post-reservation look better: p99 down to ~420ms. Will keep watch and search for root cause (noisy tenant scheduling + lack of isolation for embed-heavy bursts).
alex (support): great — Priya, I'm leaving a short runbook in the ticket: recommended production steps (dedicated capacity for regular high-volume nightly batches, or pre-scheduled reservations + explicit priority lanes). Priya: understood. We'll schedule dedicated capacity talk with acct team.
morgan (eng-sre): follow-up items for us: - evaluate autoscaler thresholds and preemption frequency on rwest-3 - consider stricter burst isolation for embed workloads - add per-tenant alert for sustained queue_time > 500ms for >5m.
Priya (AmberField): thanks all — p99 looks fixed for now. Please reference INC-20241111-amberfield for next steps and billing question for the reservation.
alex (support): noted — will convert reservation charge to a trial credit since this was mitigation. Closing slack thread, will keep ticket open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
